Or hire me for one part

Pick one service, or combine them

Audit

Growth audit

Where your growth comes from today, what limits the next stage, and whether your margins support it.

  • Review of every channel, your tracking and customer data
  • How each ad account is structured, on every ad platform
  • CAC, LTV, payback and your break-even points
  • The main constraint between you and your growth goal
  • A ranked list of what to fix first

Research

Audience research and ICP

Who buys from you, what moves them to switch, and the moments that bring them to market.

  • Market, search data and sales call analysis
  • Localised research on how each market searches and buys
  • Your ideal customer profile, scored on fit and buying signals
  • Competitor analysis: who buyers consider before choosing you

Acquisition

Paid ads setup and management

A clear account structure on each channel, built around how your buyers find and choose you.

  • Setup of new accounts or restructure of running ones on Google, Microsoft, Meta, and LinkedIn
  • Account architecture built around your margins and buying journey
  • Test rounds before budget scales
  • Targeting, creative and bids tuned to scale within your ROAS and CAC targets
  • A short weekly report and a full monthly review against your targets

Conversion

Hooks, ad copy and landing pages

Messaging that answers what holds your buyers back, so more of your existing traffic converts.

  • Positioning and copy for each audience
  • Hooks grounded in behavioural psychology
  • Messages tested in rounds, then built into one core message
  • Landing page audit showing what stops visitors from converting
  • Landing page rebuilt on the audience research

Retention

Lifecycle and CRM

Flows that move leads to a sale and customers to their next purchase, measured on revenue.

  • Nurture, onboarding, adoption and win back flows
  • Built in HubSpot or your CRM
  • Lead scoring and routing agreed with your sales team
  • Test rounds on every flow, read against a holdout
  • Behavioural triggers across the customer journey

New product growth

Product and feature launches

A new product or feature that reaches the right buyers, gets adopted, and keeps selling after launch day.

  • Competitor analysis against current alternatives
  • Clear positioning on why buyers choose you over the alternatives
  • A launch plan across the channels that fit your business and market
  • Test rounds from launch day to find what drives sales and adoption

01Conversion · Diagnostic tool

B2B Revenue Lab

Finds where a B2B company loses revenue after the lead arrives. Seven audit answers point to the weakest stage, then two or three of 14 plays run per 90 day cycle, each with an evidence tier and a payback guardrail.

02Conversion · Diagnostic tool

Ecommerce Growth Lab

Shows an online store where to start. A short diagnostic reads the store type, traffic and channels, then ranks 24 experiments across conversion, order value, kept sales and repeat orders. Every round is read on net revenue and margin.

03Acquisition · Calculator

Revenue Lab Calculator
